clue.text: There may be many calls on it to change the management

definitions.text: There may be many calls on it

parts.note: to change one thing for another is to switch
a company's management is its board of directors

explanation.surface: A suggestion that the bosses be replaced, prompting many phone calls.
explanation.definitionFit: A telephone exchange panel receives and routes incoming calls, so many calls arrive on it.

clue.text: It's drunk with beef, we hear

indicators.note: the phrase tells us the word for the complaint is only to be pronounced, not written

parts.note: a beef is slang for a complaint, as is a whine

explanation.surface: A remark about what is served to drink alongside a roast of beef.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beef' looks like the meat the drink goes with, but here it is a gripe.
explanation.definitionFit: Red vintages are a beverage people drink, often with a meal of beef.

clue.text: Call for a school period

explanation.surface: Asking what name to give to a stretch of the school year.
explanation.definitionFit: To call something is to name or designate it; a school year is divided into three sessions with that name.

clue.text: Try hand at turning valved water outlet

indicators.note: turning the letters around reshapes the words before it into a new order

explanation.surface: A firefighter tries their hand at turning the valve on a street water outlet.
explanation.definitionFit: A street fire plug is a pipe outlet with a valve that supplies water to firefighters.

clue.text: Topless females — a bad sign

indicators.note: removing the top, the first letter, of the word for the females

parts.note: females are women

explanation.surface: Women going topless in public taken as a sign of something bad.
explanation.definitionFit: A portent or augury, usually understood as a warning of trouble ahead.

clue.text: Sends back the proceeds

explanation.surface: Someone sends back the money taken in.
explanation.definitionFit: To send back is to give again to the source; financial gains or yields are also called by that plural noun.

clue.text: Trade essential for others — lock makers especially

explanation.surface: A business vital to other firms, singling out locksmiths.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is playful: those who make locks also make keys, so theirs is literally an industry of keys.
explanation.definitionFit: A vital economic sector on which others depend; also, jokingly, the business of making the metal openers for locks.

clue.text: It provides a saucy accompaniment for beefeaters

definitions.text: It provides a saucy accompaniment for beefeaters

parts.words: It provides a saucy accompaniment for beefeaters
parts.note: beefeaters suggests the Tower of London guards, but here it means people eating roast beef, and saucy means made into a sauce, not cheeky

explanation.surface: Something cheeky that goes along with the guards at the Tower of London.
explanation.walkthrough: Beefeaters are the ceremonial guards of the Tower of London; here the word is read literally as eaters of beef.
explanation.definitionFit: This pungent root is grated into a sauce traditionally served with roast beef.

clue.text: It takes me only a jiffy to write a note

parts.note: a mo, short for moment, is a jiffy

explanation.surface: Someone boasts that jotting down a note takes them no time at all.
explanation.definitionFit: A short written message or reminder, short for memorandum.

clue.text: Tenderising prepared items for cooking

indicators.note: prepared signals that the letters of the word before it are made ready in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Getting the meat-tenderising things ready to cook.
explanation.definitionFit: The components of a recipe are the things that go into a dish when cooking.

clue.text: Prejudice one found among arts graduates

indicators.note: found among signals one piece placed inside the other piece

parts.note: BA is Bachelor of Arts, so arts graduates are BAs
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Discovering a bigoted individual among a group of humanities graduates.
explanation.definitionFit: Prejudice is a slanted, unfair inclination for or against something.

clue.text: Buy drinks and loaf

explanation.surface: Paying for drinks for everyone, then idling about.
explanation.definitionFit: To buy everyone in a group a drink is to stand them a round; to loaf is to idle aimlessly.

clue.text: Dainties I'm taking time to prepare for cows

indicators.note: to prepare signals that the letters are made ready in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A cook takes their time preparing delicacies for the cows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cows' looks like the animals being fed; it is the verb meaning bullies.
explanation.definitionFit: To cow someone is to frighten them into submission, a synonym for bullying.

clue.text: Get browned off with a chap on the circle line?

parts.note: to get browned in the sun is to tan
a gent, short for gentleman, is a chap

explanation.surface: Someone fed up with a man travelling on the London Underground's Circle line.
explanation.walkthrough: The Circle line is a London Underground route; here it means a straight line that touches a circle. 'Browned off' is British slang for fed up.
explanation.definitionFit: A geometric line touching a curve at just one point, so it sits on the circle without crossing it.

clue.text: Record start of the event

indicators.note: start of picks out the first letter of the following word

parts.note: a race is a sporting event

explanation.surface: A request to record the opening of some occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: To trace is to make a record or copy of something, as a needle does on a graph.

clue.text: He's in the right position not to be found out

definitions.text: He's in the right position not to be found out

parts.words: He's in the right position not to be found out
parts.note: found out suggests being exposed, but here means being outside; someone within an organisation is placed so as never to be out of it

explanation.surface: A person safely placed so that their wrongdoing will never be discovered.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a group with privileged access is within it, never on the outside.

clue.text: Bit of land one's leased

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I, and the 's adds an S
property that is leased is let

explanation.surface: A small plot of land that someone has rented out.
explanation.definitionFit: A small island is a little piece of land in water.

clue.text: Hair used to stuff mattresses

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the following word, like a filling stuffed into it

explanation.surface: Horsehair once used as filling for mattresses.
explanation.definitionFit: A lock or long curl of hair.

clue.text: Finger-tip fastener

explanation.surface: Something at the end of the finger that holds things together.
explanation.definitionFit: The horny plate at a fingertip, and a metal spike hammered in to join wood, share one word.

clue.text: Ushered her out, being exhausted

indicators.note: out tells us a word is removed from the word before it

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A tired guest is shown out of the room.
explanation.definitionFit: Something exhausted has been consumed or spent, with nothing left.

clue.text: Bill and Edward executed

parts.note: AC is short for account, and a bill is an account
Ted is a short form of the name Edward

explanation.surface: Two men named Bill and Edward were put to death.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Executed' suggests capital punishment but means carried out, or performed on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: To act is to carry out or perform, so acted is a synonym for executed.

clue.text: Sea creature in flower

explanation.surface: A marine animal shaped like a bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: A tentacled polyp on rocks shares its name with a cup-shaped garden bloom.

clue.text: Aspired to be a giant in the literary world

definitions.text: a giant in the literary world

indicators.note: to be signals the word before it turning into something else, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A writer hoped to become a towering figure in literature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Giant' suggests a great author, but here it is a literal giant: Giant Despair in Bunyan's The Pilgrim's Progress.
explanation.definitionFit: In Bunyan's allegory, the ogre of Doubting Castle who imprisons the pilgrims is named Giant Despair.

clue.text: Is a back number, being stupid

indicators.note: back tells us the two words beside it are read in reverse order of letters

parts.note: nine is a number

explanation.surface: Calling an old magazine issue stupid.
explanation.walkthrough: A back number is an old issue of a periodical; here the phrase splits apart.
explanation.definitionFit: Asinine means foolish, like a donkey, from the Latin for ass.

clue.text: Use rent coming from these holdings

indicators.note: coming from signals the answer emerges from the letters before it, shuffled

explanation.surface: A landlord collects rent from these properties.
explanation.definitionFit: Tenures are terms or rights under which land or office is held.

clue.text: Ring smuggled in Algerian port

parts.note: a ring has the round shape of letter O
to run goods is to smuggle them, so smuggled is ran

explanation.surface: A gang of smugglers operating in a North African harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: A city on Algeria's Mediterranean coast and its second largest.

clue.text: It can be taken in a bank

explanation.surface: Something that may be accepted at a bank.
explanation.walkthrough: Sailors take in a reef by rolling up part of a sail; the bank is a ridge of rock or sand near the sea's surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A portion of sail is gathered up to shorten it in wind; also an underwater ridge of rock or coral.

clue.text: Ground plan

explanation.surface: A layout for the ground floor.
explanation.definitionFit: A small piece of land, and a scheme or conspiracy, share one word.

clue.text: Hour of the balloon's ascent

parts.note: the time a launch is set for, the countdown reaching nothing; a balloon is also round like a nought

explanation.surface: The scheduled moment for a hot-air balloon to lift off.
explanation.definitionFit: The moment when an operation or launch begins is called by this nought-hour name.

clue.text: His staff helps him reach new heights

definitions.text: His staff helps him reach new heights

parts.words: His staff helps him reach new heights
parts.note: staff suggests employees helping a career, but here it is a long pole used to vault over a high bar

explanation.surface: A rising executive whose employees boost his career.
explanation.definitionFit: An athlete who uses a long flexible pole to spring over a high crossbar.

clue.text: You want to be in it

definitions.text: You want to be in it

parts.words: You want to be in it
parts.note: want suggests desire, but in its old sense of lacking: to be in want is to be poor

explanation.surface: Something everyone would like to be part of.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in want means suffering poverty or lack, the state of hardship.

clue.text: It's useful to those in a tearing hurry

definitions.text: It's useful to those in a tearing hurry

parts.words: It's useful to those in a tearing hurry
parts.note: a tearing hurry means great haste, but here it means wanting to tear something off quickly along a line of small holes

explanation.surface: Something handy for people rushing about.
explanation.definitionFit: A row of small punched holes lets paper such as stamps or tickets be torn off neatly.
